Gated and merged. Candidate 652b839 (format fix over 9b1e62f), gated merged tree 7edec852, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1360 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures.

The bead's rescoped deliverable is met: the fixture reaches PlacementBasis.Ambiguous THROUGH THE PRODUCTION PATH -- clusterAssignments calls the same function induce calls, so the proof cannot drift from the code it proves -- and covers the stay/return/unattached near-misses that make a reached-branch claim discriminating. The 0.4/0.3/0.3 masses stay owned by m1's landed InterviewInductionSuite/InterviewProfileSuite, recorded in a comment so a reader finds the ownership boundary rather than wondering why the obvious assertion is missing.

Two process notes. The first gate of 9b1e62f reported GATE_EXIT=1 with ZERO test totals because my chain ran scalafmtCheckAll first and sbt aborts on first failure -- a whitespace nit destroyed the correctness signal. Re-run with format LAST gave the identical exit status plus 1355 passing tests, which said the logic was sound. My gate order is permanently changed and the rule is in AGENTS.md.

And the author stopped three times to ask before writing rather than after -- on the sourceChartCoverage echo, on the compatibility position, and on the two type misfits. The third stop saved a four-part widening of the receipt contract and led to the OptionalTerms split.
